overview_description.description: Delivereno is Egypt's premier on-demand delivery service. Delivereno partner with businesses and enable them to deliver products to their customers – on demand, on time, every time. We serve Restaurants, Groceries, E-Commerce, laundries, pharmacies. Delivereno revolutionizing delivery solutions in Egypt, every day. our tech-led delivery platform will help you keep your business streets ahead.
